name: Measure BP Stakeholders Oversight Committee Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
Chair  Betsy Lara
MEASURE BP STAKEHOLDERS  Vice-Chair  Pastor Elmer Jackson
OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE  Member  Jorge Hernandez
  Member  Estela Mata-Carcamo
Notice of Cancellation  Member  Gregory Orozco
January 09, 2024, 5:00 PM  Member  Sasha Rodriguez
  Member  Nghiem Van Nguyen

  NOTICE OF MEETING
  CANCELLATION

  OF THE FOLLOWING:
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE MEASURE BP
  STAKEHOLDERS OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting
of the Measure BP Stakeholders Oversight Committee of the City of
Baldwin Park scheduled for Tuesday, January 9, 2024, has been
CANCELLED.

  Said meeting was to be held in the Council Chambers,
  14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park CA, at 5:00 pm.

  The Next Regular Meeting of the Measure BP Stakeholders Oversight
Committee is scheduled for Tuesday, February 13, 2024, at 5:00 pm, Council
  Chambers, 14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park, CA.

  Notice of Cancellation was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours
  prior to the meeting.
  Dated this 4th day of January 2024

  Shirley Quiñones,
  Chief Deputy City Clerk
